tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get the current Edwyna price and page limit for a US or Canadian destination.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read the available Edwyna prepaid service-credit balance.

tools.name: create_pdf_upload
tools.description: Create a single-use 15-minute URL for handing a PDF to Edwyna. Uploading does not prepare, charge, or send a fax.

tools.name: get_pdf_upload_status
tools.description: Check whether a single-use PDF upload is ready to pass to prepare_fax.

tools.name: prepare_fax
tools.description: Validate one PDF of up to 25 pages and create a fax draft with a 30-minute quote. Provide exactly one of upload_id or pdf_base64. This does not charge the account and does not send the fax.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Consequential paid action: charge $4 of Edwyna credit and queue one prepared fax for external transmission. The same fax ID is idempotent.

tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Read the current delivery and financial status of one fax. Poll until delivered or failed; delivery typically takes 5–10 minutes and may take up to 45 minutes.

tools.name: list_faxes
tools.description: List recent fax records, optionally filtered by delivery status.

tools.name: download_delivery_record
tools.description: After delivery, retrieve Edwyna’s formal PDF record of the final delivered status and fax details.

tools.name: download_transmitted_pdf
tools.description: Optional after delivery: retrieve the PDF produced by the backend fax provider as an embedded PDF resource.
